style_context: Dog care, training, health, and canine first aid for Scouts working on the Dog Care merit badge

images.description: A teenager in a clean Scout uniform kneeling beside a medium-sized mixed-breed dog in a grassy park on a sunny day. Both are looking at each other with warmth. The dog has a wagging tail and relaxed posture. Background shows green trees and open space. No text, logos, or branding in the image.

Seven different dog breeds standing in a row on green grass in a park, each representing one AKC group: a yellow Labrador Retriever, a tricolor Beagle, a fawn Boxer, a white-and-tan Jack Russell Terrier, an orange Pomeranian, a black-and-white Border Collie, and a white-with-spots Dalmatian. Natural outdoor lighting, each dog clearly distinct.

A horizontal progression showing the physical transformation from a gray wolf on the far left to a modern domestic dog (a friendly medium-sized breed like a Labrador) on the far right, with three intermediate stages showing gradual changes in skull shape, body size, ear position, and tail carriage. Clean white background, naturalistic illustration style, no text labels.

Seven dogs sitting together on a grassy hill in a park: a chocolate Labrador Retriever, a Beagle, a Siberian Husky with blue eyes, an Airedale Terrier with wiry tan coat, a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel in Blenheim coloring, a black-and-tan German Shepherd, and a white Standard Poodle in a sporting clip. Natural lighting, each breed clearly distinguishable.

A clean side-view diagram of a medium-sized short-haired dog standing in profile on a white background. Twelve labeled body parts with thin lines pointing to each location: withers, muzzle, stop, occiput, shoulder, pastern, hock, stifle, dewclaw, croup, flank, and loin. Simple, clean line art with minimal color. Labels in small horizontal text.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform practicing a sit command with a medium-sized golden-colored dog in a fenced park. The Scout is holding a small treat above the dog's head while the dog sits attentively looking up. Green grass, wooden fence in background. Warm, encouraging scene.

Six small square panels arranged in two rows of three, showing a daily dog care routine. Each panel has a simple clock icon showing the time and an illustration: morning walk with leash, feeding at a bowl, brushing the coat, a short training session, outdoor playtime, and evening rest on a dog bed. Warm color palette, simple clean illustrations, no text beyond time indicators.

A family including a teenager visiting a clean, well-lit breeder facility. They are kneeling near a litter of golden retriever puppies while an adult breeder in casual clothes gestures and explains. An adult golden retriever sits calmly beside the breeder. Bright, welcoming atmosphere.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform measuring dry dog food with a metal measuring cup over a stainless steel dog bowl. A medium-sized dog sits patiently nearby on a kitchen floor. A small spiral notebook and pen are visible on the counter, suggesting record-keeping. Clean, well-lit kitchen setting.

Three side-by-side panels showing dog training commands. Left panel: a teenager luring a dog into a sit position by holding a treat above the dog's head. Center panel: the same teenager luring the dog into a down position with a treat moving toward the ground. Right panel: the teenager with palm extended toward the dog in a stay command. Each panel has a clean background.

A horizontal timeline spanning from left to right showing the puppy vaccination schedule. Five age markers along the timeline: 6-8 weeks, 10-12 weeks, 14-16 weeks, 12 months, and then every 3 years. Each marker has a simple syringe icon and abbreviated vaccine name below. Clean design with a blue color scheme on white background. Minimal text, only age numbers and short abbreviations.

A twelve-month calendar grid showing year-round parasite prevention for dogs. Each month cell contains small icons: a flea icon for flea-tick prevention and a heart icon for heartworm prevention. Two months are highlighted with a checkmark icon for annual vet checkup and fecal test. Clean grid layout, warm color palette, minimal text showing only month abbreviations.

Close-up photograph of gentle hands brushing a dog's teeth with a soft-bristled dog toothbrush. The dog's lip is lifted to reveal teeth and gumline. A tube of dog toothpaste sits nearby on a clean counter. The dog appears calm and cooperative. Warm indoor lighting.

A neatly arranged flat lay of dog grooming tools on a light wooden surface: a slicker brush, a bristle brush, stainless steel nail clippers, a small container of styptic powder, a bottle of dog shampoo, a metal grooming comb, and an undercoat rake. Each tool is clearly visible and identifiable. Clean, organized, well-lit.

A split-frame comparison image. Left side shows a summer scene: a teenager offering a bowl of fresh water to a panting dog under the shade of a large tree, bright sunlight in the background. Right side shows a winter scene: the same teenager wiping a dog's paws with a towel after a snowy walk, the dog wearing a warm vest, snow visible outside a doorway.

A veterinarian wearing blue surgical scrubs gently examining a calm medium-sized dog on a stainless steel exam table in a clean, modern veterinary clinic. The vet is using a stethoscope. The clinic appears bright, professional, and welcoming. No visible distress from the dog.

A teenager cautiously approaching a small injured dog lying on grass from the side, body lowered, one hand extended palm-down toward the dog. The dog is lying on its side looking wary but not aggressive. A safe distance separates them. Outdoor setting with soft natural lighting.

A four-panel instructional diagram on a clean white background showing how to apply an emergency muzzle using rolled gauze on a dog. Panel 1: a loop of gauze formed with an overhand knot. Panel 2: the loop placed over a dog's muzzle. Panel 3: the gauze tails crossed under the chin. Panel 4: the gauze tails tied in a bow behind the dog's ears. Simple line art with numbered panels.

A neatly arranged set of wound care supplies on a clean white surface: sterile gauze pads, a roll of gauze, a bottle of saline solution, a tube of antibiotic ointment, two clean white towels, blunt-tipped scissors, and non-stick wound pads. Everything clearly visible and organized.

Close-up of two hands wrapping a dog's front paw with white gauze bandage. The technique shows overlapping layers spiraling from the toes upward past the ankle. A non-stick pad is visible beneath the gauze layers at the paw pad. Three labels total: one identifying the non-stick pad layer, one pointing to the overlapping wrap technique, and one showing the extension above the ankle. No additional text or annotations.

A teenager walking a medium-sized dog on a leash along a sidewalk at dusk. The dog is wearing a reflective safety vest that catches the fading light. The sidewalk runs parallel to a residential street. Street lights are beginning to turn on. Safe, responsible walking scene.

A fully stocked pet first-aid kit laid open on a table showing neatly organized supplies including rolled gauze, non-stick pads, self-adhesive wrap, scissors, tweezers, a digital thermometer, antibiotic ointment, and rubber gloves. Four labels total: one identifying gauze and bandaging supplies, one pointing to the thermometer, one identifying the scissors and tweezers, and one for the antibiotic ointment. No additional text or annotations.

A veterinarian in a white coat using a stethoscope to examine a calm medium-sized mixed-breed dog on an exam table. The dog's owner stands nearby watching attentively. A clean, bright, modern veterinary clinic with medical equipment visible on the wall.

A shield shape divided into four equal quadrants on a clean white background. Each quadrant contains a simple icon representing a disease: a virus particle for rabies, a paw print with dots for parvovirus, lungs for distemper, and a heart with a worm for heartworm. The shield conveys protection. Minimal color palette of blue, red, green, and orange. No text in the image.

A teenager in a clean Scout uniform standing in a veterinary clinic reception area, talking with a veterinarian in a white coat. A friendly golden retriever on a leash stands between them. The clinic reception area is clean and professional with a front desk visible in the background.

Close-up photograph of a dog's collar showing a shiny metal license tag and a rabies vaccination tag hanging from the collar ring. The tags catch the light and are clearly visible. The dog has medium-length brown fur. Shallow depth of field with a soft, blurred background.

A medium-sized Border Collie mid-jump over a colorful striped agility hurdle on an outdoor agility course. Weave poles and a blue tunnel are visible in the background. A handler runs alongside. Green grass, bright sunny day. Action shot capturing the dog in the air.

Three side-by-side panels showing working dogs in action. Left panel: a yellow Labrador guide dog in a harness leading a person across a crosswalk. Center panel: a German Shepherd search-and-rescue dog wearing an orange vest climbing over rocky terrain. Right panel: a Beagle detection dog sniffing a row of suitcases at a luggage checkpoint. Each panel has a clean, distinct scene.
